name: s2-cli
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：s2-cli。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Semantic Scholar CLI (`s2`) for on-demand citation graph lookup: papers a work cites, papers that cite a work, and graph search across 200M+ papers. Use whenever the user asks for Semantic Scholar, S2, cited papers, references, bibliography, citing papers, citation count from Semantic Scholar, or papers outside a local catalog. Prefer `s2` over curl or ad-hoc Graph API requests.
